msItem.title: འཕགས་པ་དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་འོད་དཔག་མེད་ཀྱི་བཀོད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ་བཞུགས་སོ༎
_'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bzhugs so// Āryāmitābhavyūhanāmamahāyānasūtra
བདེ་ཅན
bde can
msItem.note: "ff. 42 verso and 43 recto have prayer for rebirth in Bde ba can, arranged by Dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan"
msItem.incipit: rgya gar skad du / Ar+ya a mi tA b+ha b+yU ha nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra / bod skad du / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgya pa las / 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo / 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na /
msItem.explicit: bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi 'pham pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te / bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do / / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las / 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa rdzogs so // // bam po gsum / sh+lO ka dgu brgya /
msItem.colophon: rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang dA na shI la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban d+he ye shes sde s bsgyur cing zhus te / skad gsar bcad gyis bcos nas gtan la phab la phab pa / / 'dir 'bad dge bas bde ba can / / skyes nas sems can don gyi phyir / / byang chub spyod pa kun spyad nas / / rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs par shog / / zhus dag / mang+ga laM // na mo lo ke sh+va rA ya / bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa / / yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med / / ... 'od dpag med pa'i byin rlabs chen po'i mthus / / bde x / dge ba gang bsags kun gyi nus mthu dang / / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i byin rlabs dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis / / smon lam 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub par shog / / mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar 'gyur ma thag / / bde x / skyes ma thag du sa bcu rab rdzogs te / / sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog / / ces pa yang dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bkod pa'o / / zhus dag shu b+ham / /
